en: What's the minimum number of players a team needs for a match to start or keep going?
es: ¿Con cuántos jugadores como mínimo puede un equipo empezar o seguir un partido?
cs: ¿Cuál es el mínimo de players que necesita un equipo para que el partido can start or keep going?
answer: Seven. A match may not start or continue if either team has fewer than seven players.
note: L3.1 sets the eleven-player maximum and the seven-player minimum for starting or continuing a match.

en: Are referees allowed to wear body cameras during a match?
es: ¿Los árbitros pueden llevar cámaras corporales durante el partido?
cs: ¿Los refs pueden usar body cams durante el partido, or is that not allowed?
answer: Yes, if the competition organiser supplies the cameras, controls the footage and follows the relevant guidelines. The cameras may have microphones, but those cannot be used to broadcast communication with the VAR.
note: L5.5.2 lists body cameras among the optional referee equipment and gives the conditions for using them.

en: Where does a goal kick have to be taken from, and when is the ball in play?
es: ¿Desde dónde se tiene que cobrar el saque de meta y en qué momento ya está en juego el balón?
cs: ¿Desde dónde se cobra el goal kick, and when is the ball officially en juego?
answer: From any point inside the goal area, with the ball stationary, by a player of the defending team. The ball is in play as soon as it is kicked and clearly moves.
note: L16.1 is the goal kick procedure: where the kick is taken, when the ball is in play and where opponents must be.

en: Does the team captain have any special rights with the referee?
es: ¿El capitán del equipo tiene algún derecho especial ante el árbitro?
cs: ¿El capitán tiene some kind of special rights con el árbitro, or is he just another player?
answer: No. Each team must have a captain on the field wearing an armband, but the captain has no special status or privileges, only a degree of responsibility for the team's behaviour.
note: L3.10 defines the captain's role and says the captain has no special status; it also mentions the optional 'Only the captain' guidelines.

en: What kinds of decisions can the VAR step in on?
es: ¿En qué tipo de jugadas puede intervenir el VAR?
cs: ¿En qué tipo de jugadas can the VAR actually step in?
answer: Only clear and obvious errors or serious missed incidents about goal or no goal, penalty or no penalty, red cards (including a clearly wrong second caution) and mistaken identity. As a competition option it also covers a clearly wrong corner kick award that can be corrected immediately without delaying the restart.
note: L5.4.0 lists the categories of decision in which the VAR may assist the referee.

en: Why does the ref sometimes hold the whistle after a foul when stopping things would only hurt the side that got fouled, and can he still call it a moment later if nothing comes of it?
es: ¿Por qué a veces el silbante se guarda el pitazo después de una falta cuando marcarla perjudicaría al que la recibió, y todavía la marca un momento después si no salió nada?
cs: ¿Por qué a veces the ref se guarda el pitazo after a foul, cuando marcarla would only hurt al que la recibió? And can he still call it un momento después si no salió nada?
answer: The referee lets the game go on when the fouled team would be better off that way. If the expected benefit does not materialise right then or within a few seconds, the referee goes back and penalises the original offence.
note: L5.3.1 is the advantage clause. Avoided EN: advantage, play, continue, offence, benefit, penalise, opposing, team, seconds, restart, ball. Avoided ES: ventaja, juego, prosiga, infracción, equipo, adversario, beneficiar, sancionar, segundos, reanudación, balón. Also: G.football-terms.advantage (definition only).

en: Can a defender swap jobs with the teammate who guards the net in the middle of a match, and what has to happen for that to be allowed?
es: ¿Se vale que un defensa se ponga los guantes y se pase al arco en lugar del portero a medio partido? ¿Qué hace falta para que sea legal?
cs: ¿Se vale que un defensa swap jobs con el portero in the middle of a match? What has to happen para que sea legal?
answer: Yes. Any player may trade positions with the goalkeeper as long as the referee is told beforehand and the switch happens while play is stopped.
note: L3.4 gives the two conditions for a player changing places with the goalkeeper. Avoided EN: goalkeeper, keeper, change, places, player, referee, informed, stoppage, play. Avoided ES: guardameta, intercambiar, cambio, puesto, jugador, árbitro, informar, juego, detenido. Also: L3.5 (covers only the sanction when it is done without permission).

en: How does the match get going again when a forward's shot misses and leaves the pitch at the end, beside the net, with no defender getting a piece of it?
es: ¿Cómo se reinicia el partido cuando un delantero tira desviado y la pelota sale por el fondo, a un lado del arco, sin que ningún defensa la roce?
cs: ¿Cómo se reinicia el partido when a forward's shot misses y la pelota sale por el fondo, a un lado del arco, with no defender getting a piece of it?
answer: With a goal kick for the defending team, because the whole ball crossed the goal line last touched by an attacker and no goal was scored.
note: L16.0 states when a goal kick is awarded. Avoided EN: goal, kick, awarded, ball, line, touched, player, attacking, team, scored, corner, opponents. Avoided ES: saque, meta, balón, línea, tocar, jugador, equipo, atacante, gol, portería, adversario, esquina.

en: If whoever has the whistle calls the whole thing off because of a storm and somebody ends up hurt or out of pocket, can they sue him over it?
es: Si el silbante cancela todo por una tormenta y alguien sale lastimado o le cuesta dinero, ¿hay manera de demandarlo?
cs: Si el silbante calls the whole thing off por una tormenta and somebody ends up lastimado o le cuesta dinero, can they sue him?
answer: No. Under the Laws a referee or other match official is not held liable for injury, property damage or any other loss that results from a decision made under the Laws, and abandoning a match or judging the weather are named examples.
note: L5.7 is the liability clause for match officials. Avoided EN: referee, match, official, liable, injury, damage, property, loss, decision, weather, conditions, abandon, player, spectator, club. Avoided ES: árbitro, equipo arbitral, responsable, lesión, daño, propiedad, pérdida, decisión, partido, condiciones meteorológicas, suspender, jugador, espectador, club.

en: If someone in the starting eleven is shown a red card during warm-ups, does his side begin a man short or can somebody from the bench step in?
es: Si a un titular le sacan la roja en el calentamiento, ¿su cuadro arranca con diez o entra alguien de la banca en su lugar?
cs: Si a un titular le sacan la roja during warm-ups, ¿su cuadro arranca con diez or can somebody from the bench step in?
answer: A player sent off after the team list is in but before kick-off may be replaced by a named substitute, which means the team can still start with eleven. That substitute's spot on the bench cannot be refilled, and the team's number of substitutions is not reduced.
note: L3.6 covers players sent off before the team list, between the list and kick-off, and after kick-off. Avoided EN: player, sent off, team list, named, kick-off, replaced, substitute, substitutions, number, reduced. Avoided ES: jugador, expulsado, lista, equipo, inscrito, saque inicial, sustituido, suplente, sustituciones, número, reducir. Also: L5.3.2 (gives the referee's authority before kick-off but not the replacement rule).

en: A substitute warming up along the touchline steps onto the field near midfield and kicks away a pass meant for an opposing winger. The referee stops play. What is the restart, and what happens to the substitute?
es: Un suplente que está calentando junto a la banda se mete a la cancha cerca del medio campo y desvía un pase que iba para un extremo rival. El árbitro detiene el juego. ¿Cómo se reanuda y qué pasa con el suplente?
cs: Un suplente que estaba warming up junto a la banda se mete a la cancha near midfield y desvía un pase que iba para un winger del otro equipo. El árbitro para el juego. What's the restart, y qué le pasa al sub?
answer: Play restarts with a direct free kick for the opponents (it would be a penalty kick where that applies). The substitute is removed from the field and the referee takes appropriate disciplinary action.
note: L3.7 says interference by a substitute who enters the field is restarted with a direct free kick or penalty kick, with removal and disciplinary action.

en: With his team up 1-0 late in the match, a goalkeeper keeps stalling over a goal kick. The referee blows the whistle and counts down five seconds with a raised hand, and the kick still has not been taken. What is the ruling?
es: Su equipo va ganando 1-0 al final del partido y el portero se tarda a propósito en cobrar un saque de meta. El árbitro pita y hace la cuenta regresiva de cinco segundos con la mano levantada, y el portero sigue sin sacar. ¿Qué se marca?
cs: Su equipo va ganando 1-0 late in the game y el portero keeps stalling en un saque de meta. The ref pita y hace el five-second countdown con la mano arriba, and he still doesn't take it. ¿Qué se marca?
answer: A corner kick is awarded to the opposing team. The goalkeeper is cautioned only if he goes on to excessively delay the restart after the corner kick has been given.
note: L16.2 describes the five-second countdown for a delayed goal kick and the corner kick that follows. Also: L17.0 (lists the delay as a reason for a corner kick but not the countdown or the caution condition).

en: A midfielder is hurt by a reckless tackle and the opponent is shown a yellow card for it. The physio comes on to check him. Does he have to leave the field and wait before coming back?
es: A un mediocampista lo lastiman con una entrada temeraria y al rival le sacan la amarilla por eso. Entra el médico a revisarlo. ¿Tiene que salir de la cancha y esperar para volver a entrar?
cs: A un mediocampista lo lastiman con una entrada temeraria and the other guy gets a yellow for it. Entra el médico to check on him. Does he have to salir de la cancha y esperar before coming back in?
answer: No. A player whose injury stops play normally has to leave and may return only one minute after play restarts, but one of the listed exceptions is an injury caused by a physical offence for which the opponent is cautioned or sent off.
note: L5.3.3 holds the leave-the-field requirement for injured players and its list of exceptions, including the cautioned-opponent case.

en: A team scores, and before the kick-off the referee realises that a player of that team who had already been substituted was still on the field and helped set up the goal. What should the referee do?
es: Un equipo mete gol y, antes de que se saque del centro, el árbitro se da cuenta de que un jugador de ese equipo que ya había sido cambiado seguía dentro de la cancha y participó en la jugada del gol. ¿Qué debe hacer el árbitro?
cs: Un equipo mete gol and before the kick-off el árbitro se da cuenta de que un jugador de ese equipo who had already been subbed off seguía en la cancha y participó en la jugada. What should the ref do?
answer: Disallow the goal, have the substituted player removed, and restart with a direct free kick from the position where that extra person was. The incident is also reported to the authorities.
note: L3.9 covers a goal scored with an extra person on the field who interfered, when it is noticed before play restarts, including the case where that person belongs to the scoring team.

en: The substitution board goes up, but the player coming off walks slowly and is still on the field after ten seconds, with no injury or safety issue. What happens with the substitution?
es: Muestran el tablero del cambio, pero el jugador que sale se va caminando despacio y a los diez segundos sigue dentro de la cancha, sin estar lesionado ni haber un problema de seguridad. ¿Qué pasa con el cambio?
cs: Sacan el tablero del cambio, but the guy coming off se va caminando bien lento and after ten seconds sigue dentro de la cancha, no injury ni nada. ¿Qué pasa con el cambio?
answer: The player must still leave, but the substitute may not come on yet and play restarts without him. The substitution cannot be cancelled or switched to another substitute, and the substitute may enter with the referee's permission at the first stoppage after one minute has passed since the restart; the departing player is cautioned only for excessive delay beyond the ten seconds.
note: L3.5 lists the consequences when the player being substituted does not leave within the required ten seconds. Also: L3.3 (sets the ten-second requirement but not the consequences).

en: Play has already restarted when the referee finds out that a player punched an opponent off the ball. Can the referee still send that player off, and in what situations?
es: El juego ya se reanudó cuando el árbitro se entera de que un jugador le dio un puñetazo a un rival lejos del balón. ¿Todavía lo puede expulsar, y en qué casos?
cs: El juego ya se reanudó when the ref finds out que un jugador le soltó un puñetazo a un rival off the ball. Can he still expulsarlo, y en qué casos?
answer: Yes, in limited cases. A sanction after the restart is possible if another match official had spotted the offence and tried to communicate it before play restarted, and where VAR is in use a review after a restart is still allowed for a potential sending-off for violent conduct. The restart tied to the offence is not applied.
note: L5.2 gives the general limit on sanctions after a restart and the other-match-official exception; L5.4.1 gives the VAR exception for violent conduct after play has restarted.

en: A goal kick is caught by a strong wind and blows straight back into the kicker's own goal without anyone touching it. What is the restart, and if the other team then puts that restart straight into the net, does it count?
es: Un saque de meta agarra un ventarrón y el balón se regresa directo a la portería del mismo equipo que sacó, sin que nadie lo toque. ¿Cómo se reanuda el juego? Y si el rival mete ese cobro directo a la red, ¿cuenta el gol?
cs: Un saque de meta agarra un ventarrón and the ball goes straight back a la portería del mismo equipo, sin que nadie lo toque. What's the restart? Y si el otro equipo lo mete directo, does the goal count?
answer: There is no own goal; the opponents are awarded a corner kick. A goal may be scored directly from a corner kick against the opposing team, and that goal counts.
note: L16.0 says a goal kick that goes directly into the kicker's own goal gives a corner kick to the opponents; L17.0 says a goal can be scored directly from a corner kick against the opposing team.

en: A fan blows a whistle and a midfielder stops with the ball at his feet near the centre circle, and the referee stops play. How does play restart, who gets the ball, and how far away must everyone else be?
es: Alguien en la tribuna suena un silbato y un mediocampista se frena con el balón en los pies cerca del círculo central, y el árbitro detiene el juego. ¿Cómo se reanuda, a quién le toca el balón y a qué distancia deben estar los demás?
cs: Alguien en la tribuna blows a whistle y un mediocampista se frena con el balón en los pies near the center circle, and the ref para el juego. ¿Cómo se reanuda, who gets the ball, y a qué distancia tienen que estar los demás?
answer: With a dropped ball. Because the ball was outside the penalty area, it is dropped where it was for one player of the team that would have kept possession, and all other players must stay at least 4 m (4.5 yds) away until it is in play.
note: L5.3.4 says a spectator's whistle that interferes with play leads to a dropped ball; L8.2.1 says who receives the dropped ball, where it is dropped and the 4 m distance.

en: A defender is sent to the sideline because of a bleeding cut. Without waiting for the referee's signal he runs back on and intercepts a pass. What does the referee do, and how does play restart?
es: A un defensa lo mandan fuera de la cancha porque trae una cortada que le sangra. Sin esperar la señal del árbitro se vuelve a meter y corta un pase. ¿Qué hace el árbitro y cómo se reanuda el juego?
cs: A un defensa lo sacan de la cancha because he's bleeding de una cortada. Sin esperar la señal del ref he runs back on y corta un pase. What does the ref do, y cómo se reanuda el juego?
answer: A bleeding player may only come back on the referee's signal. Since he re-entered without permission and interfered with play, the referee stops play, cautions him, and restarts with a direct free kick from the position of the interference.
note: L5.3.3 says a bleeding player needs the referee's signal to re-enter; L3.8 gives the caution and the direct free kick for a player who re-enters without permission and interferes.
